properties.content: Question: children covid symptom Answer: Symptoms of COVID-19 in Children Children can experience a wide range of symptoms, which may vary in severity. Common symptoms include: Fever, Cough, Sore throat, Runny nose, Congestion, Headache, Fatigue, Muscle aches, Nausea, Vomiting, and Diarrhea. Infants and Young Children Infants and young children may exhibit additional symptoms, such as: Irritability, Decreased appetite, Difficulty feeding, Lethargy, and Seizures (rare). Asymptomatic Cases Some children may have COVID-19 without showing any symptoms. Note: It's important to consult a healthcare professional if your child experiences any symptoms that may be related to COVID-19.

Question: children covid symptom

Answer: Symptoms of COVID-19 in Children
Children can experience a wide range of symptoms, which may vary in severity. Common symptoms include:
Fever, Cough, Sore throat, Runny nose, Congestion, Headache, Fatigue, Muscle aches, Nausea, Vomiting, and Diarrhea.
Infants and Young Children
Infants and young children may exhibit additional symptoms, such as:
Irritability, Decreased appetite, Difficulty feeding, Lethargy, and Seizures (rare).
Asymptomatic Cases
Some children may have COVID-19 without showing any symptoms.
Note: It's important to consult a healthcare professional if your child experiences any symptoms that may be related to COVID-19.
